A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|agent]]''' worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was seen on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] working with an [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Arzanon]], searching for traitor [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] who wanted to throw down the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] order.
